description: Defines the OpusHeader struct, constants, and function prototypes for parsing and writing Opus audio headers within the Android media framework.

classes.name: OpusHeader
classes.description: Structure representing the Opus audio header parameters.

methods.name: ParseOpusHeader
methods.description: Parses raw data to extract Opus header information.

methods.name: WriteOpusHeader
methods.description: Serializes an OpusHeader struct into a byte buffer.

methods.name: GetOpusHeaderBuffers
methods.description: Retrieves various buffers related to the Opus header, codec delay, and seek preroll.

methods.name: WriteOpusHeaders
methods.description: Writes multiple Opus headers including delay and preroll information.

methods.name: IsOpusHeader
methods.description: Checks if given data corresponds to an Opus header.
